parsed.internal_thinking: Jimmy is currently leading with 3 VP and has already played a Monopoly card, which severely damaged my trust. He's offering 1 Wheat for 1 Brick. Looking at my resources, I have 3 Wheat and only 1 Brick. My Brick production comes from node 20 (Brick 6), which is decent, but Brick is a very scarce and valuable resource right now, especially since the other Brick source (H13 - B10) is blocked by the robber. Jimmy already has 3 Wheat and 2 Wood; giving him my only Brick likely allows him to build yet another settlement or road, further cementing his lead. I have plenty of Wheat production (nodes 44 and 20), so I don't need his Wheat. Accepting this trade would be strategically poor and goes against my goal of not helping the leader who recently betrayed the table with a Monopoly.
parsed.note_to_self: Rejected Jimmy's trade (1 Wheat for 1 Brick). Brick is too scarce and Jimmy is leading. My Wheat production is already strong (9 and 6), so I don't need more. Need to keep an eye on Jimmy's Wood/Brick count.
parsed.say_outloud: ג'ימי, באמת? אחרי המונופול שעשית לנו על הטיט, אתה מבקש ממני את הטיט האחרון שלי בשביל חיטה? יש לי מספיק חיטה, תודה. אני לא עוזרת לך לברוח עם הניצחון.
